document: Alone Against the Tide Solitaire Adventure by The Lakeshore (Call of Cthulhu MPRG 23174) (Nicholas Johnson, Lynne Hardy, Mike Mason etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
On reaching the top of the stairs, you emerge into the belfry 
and find yourself looking down on the rapidly-flooding, fog-
shrouded town. You glance out at the lake, which is no longer 
covered by the fog. You see the surface swelling and falling 
strangely beneath unnaturally massive waves, as well as the stars 
and gibbous moon reflected in the seething water.

Finding yourself in relative safety, you finally have a moment 
to pause and reflect. You take a deep breath, bowing your head in 
thought— or, perhaps, prayer. Your mind is in a whirl but, eventually, 
a single thought breaks through, determining your course of action.

• If you know a ritual chant, now is the time you may choose to use it. 
Check the entry number noted on your investigator sheet, then go to it.
